artworks.instagramCaption:
The Geometry of Being
21 × 29.7 cm (A4), markers on paper, 2026

From the Chromatic Innerverse series.

Within the mathematical architecture of the universe, a solitary living presence reminds us that freedom can exist even within the most carefully constructed order.

#GeometricAbstraction #ChromaticHarmony #Consciousness #Freedom #CelestialGeometry #Existence #BirdSymbolism #VisualEquilibrium #MathematicalAesthetics #OrganicLife #UniversalOrder #ContemporaryArt #ColorTheory #GeometricComposition #Minimalism #AbstractDrawing #ConceptualArt #MarkersOnPaper #ChromaticExpression #CosmicBalance #VisualPhilosophy #SpatialRelationships #Duality #Interconnectedness #ArtisticSymbolism #InnerUniverse #GeometricRhythm #EmotionalAbstraction #NatureAndGeometry #ChromaticInnerverse
